slides.photo_prompt: Photorealistic lifestyle photo, vertical 4:5. A cozy evening corner by a window with a dark blue sky outside, the hands of a Korean woman in her 20s wrapped around a warm ceramic cup of herbal tea with gentle steam rising, a small glass teapot and a lit candle on a wooden tray, a soft knit blanket over her lap, face out of frame. slides.title: Is this [[you]]?
items: Cold nights, no time to pause

slides.title: No [[pause]] in your day
slides.body: Work, dinner, scrolling, bed. When one task runs right into the next, there's no moment that tells you the day is wrapping up.
slides.speech: A small break is okay too~

slides.title: Cold nights feel [[long]]
slides.body: When it gets dark and chilly early, it's easy to fill the evening with screens. A warm, slow ritual gives those long hours a gentle shape.

items.head: Pick a caffeine-free cup
items.sub: Try chamomile, barley or warm water

items.head: Set a 10-minute tea time
items.sub: Same time each night, phone aside

items.head: Sip slowly, breathe out
items.sub: Hold the warm cup and just pause

slides.title: Tea time [[checklist]]
slides.note: Lifestyle tips only. If it lasts, talk to a professional.

slides.title: Cozy cups with [[Calm]]~
slides.body: Save, share and tell a friend

caption:
Evenings slipping away on your phone? 🍵

When work, dinner and scrolling run together, there's no moment to pause, and long, chilly nights make it easy to stay on screens.
Try three small habits starting tonight:
Pick a caffeine-free cup · Set a 10-minute tea time · Sip slowly and breathe out
